messages:
anya: Heads-up: hitting a weird rotation bug during onboarding demos. containerized sample-app still authenticates with old token after KMS rotation when both REDWOOD_API_KEY and REDWOOD_TOKEN are mounted. repro and notes below.

samir: ugh that rings a bell. can you drop the repro + logs? :mag:

anya: repro steps:
```
# container uses downward API to mount REDWOOD_TOKEN (old token)
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=new-api-from-console
# but deployment has REDWOOD_TOKEN in env from secret mount (old)
kubectl rollout restart deploy/sample-app
# app logs show: auth: using token <redacted-old>
# requests fail 401 until pod restarted twice
```
logs: "auth middleware: authenticated with REDWOOD_TOKEN -- token expired according to service"

jules: sounds like two issues: 1) env var precedence is inconsistent across SDKs (node/python/cpp), 2) credential cache/refresh in the runtime ignores changes when a legacy alias is present.

samir: concrete root cause: in our credential resolver we currently treat REDWOOD_TOKEN as highest priority in the C++ runtime (historical), but Node/Python prefer REDWOOD_API_KEY. when both exist, some runtimes never reach the new key path. also, our in-memory cred cache does not detect that an env-mounted secret changed because the variable name didn't change.

anya: additional wrinkle: people use REDWOOD_ORG and RW_PROJECT env combos in internal sampleapps, so rotating org-scoped keys quietly breaks cross-project resolution. we have no clear precedence doc for org vs project-scoped keys.

jules: proposal:
- standardize env precedence: REDWOOD_API_KEY > REDWOOD_TOKEN (legacy) > RW_LEGACY_KEY
- add explicit rules for org/project scoping: if REDWOOD_ORG present, prefer org-scoped key; if RW_PROJECT present, emit warning and fall back.
- publish a small shared package "@redwood/creds" (and py equivalent) that all SDKs import for parity.
- make credential cache watch env var values on start and invalidate if value differs from cache. for k8s downward API mounts this will detect rotation after restart or SIGHUP.
- add CLI flag `--refresh-credentials` and signal handler to force reload without full restart.

samir: +1. also add telemetry events: cred_resolution.source and cred_resolution.deprecated_alias so we can count legacy usage.

anya: test plan:
- unit tests for resolver order and org/project precedence
- e2e that simulates secret rotation via k8s downward API (we can mock by writing env file in test container)
- compatibility tests across node/python/cpp SDKs referencing the shared package.

jules: implementation note: try to avoid breaking users who intentionally set both by logging a WARN on startup when both are present and showing which one was chosen. put deprecation timeline in UNIFIED_KEYS.md.

eng-ci: build queued for branch feat/cred-resolver-shared (#2789). will run matrix across node/py/cpp.

anya: docs action: can we add a short quickstart appendix that explains env var precedence, org/project scoping, and rotation steps for k8s (Downward API vs secret mount advice)? customers keep tripping on this.

doc-bot: docs ticket created: DOCS-4321 "Env var precedence & rotation guide". assigned to @maria-docs.

samir: follow-up: jules can you prototype the resolver API (JS + py shim) and i'll wire it into sample-app + runtime. ping me on PR for perf review (watch for extra overhead on cold start).

anya: thanks y'all. if we can get the shared resolver in next sprint, should cut support tickets in half. will post a short note in onboarding playbook when PR is merged. :rocket:
